product_overview: Attendance By Intelligence (ABI) is a role-based attendance management app for admins and staff. It supports credential-based login, student record management, section-based attendance marking, and analytics/report export.
core_goals: Sign in with authorized credentials to access the system
Mark attendance for students in a selected section
Add, import, and remove student records
View attendance analytics and export reports

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Let authorized users sign in with their username, password, and UID, with optional passkey verification.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Fill in username -> Fill in password -> Fill in UID -> Submit login form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to / -> Fill in username -> Fill in password -> Fill in UID -> Submit login form -> Choose to verify with passkey when prompted -> Complete passkey verification -> See the dashboard

features.name: Attendance Tracking
features.description: Allow authenticated users to record attendance for a chosen section and handle absentee sharing when needed.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Select a target section -> Search or filter the student list -> Mark students as present or absent -> Confirm attendance submission -> See the attendance record saved

Navigate to / -> Select a target section -> Search or filter the student list -> Mark students as absent -> Confirm attendance submission -> Confirm WhatsApp sharing for absentees -> See the absentee list prepared for sharing

features.name: Student Management
features.description: Allow authenticated users to register students manually, import students in bulk, and remove existing student records.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open manual enrollment -> Fill in student details -> Register the student -> See the new student added to the registry
Navigate to / -> Open bulk import -> Select a file for import -> Execute the import -> See the imported student records added to the registry
Navigate to / -> Browse the student registry -> Remove a student record -> See the record removed from the registry

features.name: Analytics Reports
features.description: Let authenticated users view attendance analytics by class or individual view and export the results.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Switch to class or individual report view -> Select a section and date range -> Generate insights -> See attendance analytics on screen
Navigate to / -> Select a section and date range -> Generate insights -> Download or export the report -> Receive the exported attendance file
